label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Ian Poulter knee injury
items.text: Ian Poulter tore his knee meniscus hopping up two steps at a LIV Golf event and will have surgery in September, though he continues competing while managing pain.

items.headline: Jaeger withdraws with injury
items.text: Stephan Jaeger withdrew mid-round from the $9.9M Charles Schwab Challenge due to a back injury confirmed by PGA Tour Communications.

items.headline: 2026 Memorial field announced
items.text: Scottie Scheffler will defend his Memorial Tournament title June 4, headlining a field including Rory McIlroy and Jordan Spieth; Viktor Hovland withdrew before deadline.
